note: Track steps-to-leaps (voice-intervals), step 8: Do Mi Sol up and back over a drone, from the low Do. Rewritten from the plan exercise (ChoiceSplit3): its Key selector (A, C, D) is a move now (any key), so the text names no selector and says what stays the same in another key. In every key the drill is the lowest three notes of the staff, and the care line says so, because the staff also shows the notes above them.

exercise.title: Do Mi Sol from any Do
exercise.why: Do Mi Sol is two skips of a fixed size, so it sounds the same from any Do, and moving it trains your ear on the shape and not on the notes.

cells.text:
Press Start exercise below to start the drone and the mic. Sing {{1}} {{3}} {{5}} up and back, starting from the low {{1}}. Sing it on the note names.
Stay with it until the three notes land without a slide between them.
In another key the notes are new, and the two skips are still the same size.
_Don't reach for high notes: this drill is the lowest three notes on the staff._
